summary: Access reviews now run per department on rules you set, and departments without an owner are flagged daily.

new.title: Review rules per department
new.text: On Access reviews, Review rules sets how often each department is reviewed, for how long, by whom and with one or two approvers. A department can also opt out.

new.title: Departments without an owner are reported
new.text: A department without an owner is reported to the alert recipients every day until someone names an owner.
